title: Qualification suitcase
stop.title: Cuts transmission at once (T 0) and stops the current test
stop.failed: STOP sent, but the cut could not be confirmed: {message}. Check the rig.
menu.title: What next?
menu.hint: Advised order: left to right, row by row.
question: Question from the suitcase
waiting: The suitcase is working… the log below updates.
finished: The suitcase has ended: you can close this page.
lost: Connection to the suitcase lost: retrying…
iv.title: ACTION REQUIRED
iv.word: Type the word {word} on the keyboard
iv.rule: The words CHARGE, ANTENNE and EMETTRE must be typed on the keyboard by yourself, to be certain that you agree with the test about to be made and that your rig is available as requested.
iv.paste: Paste refused: type the word on the keyboard.
iv.wrong: The word does not match: type exactly {word}, or « Skip this test ».
why.CHARGE: The next tests make the rig TRANSMIT: it must be on the dummy load, never on the antenna. Only a person next to the rig can confirm it.
why.ANTENNE: Reception is measured on the antenna. No transmission in this part; afterwards, no transmission until you type CHARGE again.
why.EMETTRE: The rig is about to TRANSMIT. Only a person next to the rig can allow it.
err.not_word: This window is only for safety words.
err.not_typed: Word refused: it must be typed on the keyboard (paste refused).
err.word_window: A safety word can only be given in the action window.
err.closed: This question no longer expects an answer.
